PA3 updated from 3.32.4 to 3.32.7. Here is what changed:

- **External coders hand off on time (3.32.7).** OpenRouter sends a reply's token counts only at its end, so PA3 thought DeepSeek coders had used zero tokens while they ran. Because of that, they never got the "save your progress and hand off" request at the 350k-token context limit. Some ran far past it, and one ran until its model refused the prompt as too long. They now get that request on time, like in-house coders. The statusline also shows each external coder's context, and its tokens and spend move while it runs.
- **No more red rows for launches PA3 turned away (3.32.7).** A coder refused at launch for learning mode, a full lane or a duplicate no longer leaves a red row on the statusline. It never ran.
- **No more `?/?` on the Session line (3.32.6).** A tiny rounding difference made a session look bigger than its account. The line now shows the real numbers.
- **Updates that can't get stuck (3.32.5).** A slow download now finishes in the background instead of being dropped after 8 seconds. That was probably why the update check failed at the last session start on WSL. If an update ever fails, I'll say so with the one command to run. A release you skip with "Not now" is offered again every 8 hours.

Project Architect 3.32.7, a hotfix (External coders count their tokens and hand off on time), is installed.

**To load it: /exit, then claude --continue (not /clear)**

PA3 updated from 3.32.7 to 3.32.8. Here is what changed:

- **The savings figures were too high, and are now honest.** Each time an agent read PA3's journal of decisions, the ledger counted it as savings, although a plain Claude Code session has no journal. On a busy project that was about two thirds of a week's measured savings. Journal reads now count nothing, and a one-time repair removes the credits already booked. So the Session and Project lines will show lower savings figures. I'll tell you once the repair has run.
- **External coder rows keep their details.** A DeepSeek coder's statusline row sometimes lost its model name and token count. It's now named from the coder's brief itself.
- **One more `?/?` fix.** The Session line could still show `?/?` after a turn when only this session was spending. It now compares against the account's total taken at the same moment.

Project Architect 3.32.8, a hotfix (Honest savings, steadier statusline rows), is installed.

**To load it: /exit, then claude --continue (not /clear)**

I've written the bug up, but only one of the two bugs is real. I was wrong about the sandbox failures. I checked the launcher (`tools/pa_ext.py:836-853`), and since PA3 3.30.7 a sandbox (bwrap) failure no longer counts against learning mode. That leaves the `../` refusals, which I've written up with the evidence.

**The bug.** PA3 has a fixed rule that refuses commands touching anything outside the project. It works out relative paths from the project's top folder, not from the folder the coder is actually in. It also treats a quoted text argument as a path. Both refusals in T11 were for commands that stayed inside the project:
- **RM3.** The coder was in a subfolder of `.run/` and ran `cd ../func_801919A0…`. That was refused as `/home/musashi/func_801919A0…`, which is `../` taken from the project's top folder.
- **G23x.** The coder passed the C include string `"../shared/ov/func_8012DBD0.h"` as an argument. That was refused as `/home/musashi/shared/…`, though it's not a file the command opens.

Each refusal counts against learning mode, which is why it matters. DeepSeek's third note works around it for now.

**To file it.** Type `/pa-bugreport` yourself, because I can't run slash commands. It writes a file for you to attach to a GitHub issue. Paste or attach my write-up too: `/home/musashi/bfm-decomp/.run/3.40/pa-bugreport-notes.md`. That folder is scratch space, so once it's filed you don't need to keep the file.

T12 is still finishing up, and nothing starts after it. I've released the talk hold.
